Kurukṣetra is indeed superior to all sacred fields;

Even more than Naimiṣāraṇya in this entire orb of the earth,

Then, when a man of resolute mind has traversed half the way to Prayāga,

Whatever sins reside in the physical body made of seven bodily elements,

Having thus become free of taint, he should then bathe in the confluent waters of the white and dark [rivers];
